topic: whether social media accounts should require age verification
instructions: use no sentence longer than twenty words
include one deliberate sentence fragment for emphasis
write the final paragraph in second person throughout
text:
Young minds face complex societal issues daily.  
One question demands an urgent answer: Should platforms verify ages?  
Yes, strict systems are necessary everywhere now.  

Critics cite privacy worries as a barrier often enough.  
The risks of leaving children unfiltered far outweigh inconvenience here.  
Child safety is the primary argument for this change today.  

Algorithms push users toward violent or harmful content easily.  
Platforms like TikTok and X rely on weak methods mostly.  
Minors bypass these barriers using parental accounts too freely.  
Children under eighteen face psychological harm they cannot process well.  
Without hard barriers, predatory creators exploit vulnerable youth openly.  

This shield aligns with the legal definition of majority perfectly.  
It protects minors from exploitation before consent is possible there.  
Parents should never bear this burden alone or fully depend on self-reporting either.  
Current systems assume perfect supervision in every household always.  
That expectation remains unrealistic when children use devices without oversight now.  

Mandatory verification shifts responsibility to platforms for active gatekeeping duties instead.  
Critics claim strict checks will stifle free speech badly enough (but safety matters more).  
Platforms can verify proof of age via decentralized technology easily.  
Only identity is confirmed while personal data stays private mostly.  
This ensures compliance without creating a surveillance state ever after.  

Ethical obligations cannot be ignored by any major network today.  
Targeted ads based on tracking children end under GDPR-K rules strictly.  
Unverified minors undermine public trust and devalue privacy rights for everyone soon.  
Data breaches will occur inevitably, as recent scandals show clearly enough.  

You must recognize that stakes are too high to ignore now.  
A safer digital environment requires closing loopholes immediately today.  
Loopholes allow minors to exist anonymously on adult platforms currently still.  
Strict age gates must become the global standard for participation everywhere soon.
